name: Balanced Dollar
oneLiner: bnUSD is Balanced's decentralized dollar stablecoin on ICON, minted from overcollateralized CDPs against sICX and bridged cross-chain via xCall.
collateral: Overcollateralized loans on ICON against sICX (staked ICX), with cross-chain Hub collateral support for assets bridged in via Balanced's xCall infrastructure
pegMechanism: CDP-style mint: users borrow bnUSD against eligible collateral on the ICON Hub through the Balanced Loans contract, paying a 0.2% origination fee and a 2% annualised interest charge; loans must remain above the protocol's collateral ratio or are eligible for liquidation. The same bnUSD supply circulates wrapper-free across connected chains via xCall, so cross-chain balances net back to the canonical ICON issuance.

oracleRisk.summary: The historical bnUSD v1 design used external collateral pricing, with public sources tying Balanced oracle integration to Band. Balanced's current documentation says the v1 app is no longer supported after the April 2026 v2 launch, so the active v2 oracle and failover path are not established for this tracked v1 record.
oracleRisk.reviewer: SONG-1 Safety Score V9 evidence review

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At ICON block 115645618, the canonical bnUSD SCORE was active and registered Balanced Governance as its owner. The exact v1.1.2 deployed archive exposes govTransfer, which only Governance may use to move bnUSD from an arbitrary source address, and calls checkStatus before ordinary transfers. The exact v1.0.3 Governance archive has owner-only control paths, and its active owner is a single EOA. This is a direct canonical holder-control surface; upstream reserve exposure remains separate.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: TERRA-III Safety Score V9 access review

mintAuthority.summary: bnUSD minting is limited on ICON to the registered Balanced Loans and Peg Stability SCOREs, subject to the token debt ceiling; the current owner of the Governance SCORE is a single EOA that can raise that ceiling and upgrade mint-critical SCORE logic.

controls.label: Balanced Loans SCORE
controls.capDescription: At ICON block 115645618, the bnUSD SCORE debt ceiling was 8,000,000 bnUSD; only the registered Loans or Peg Stability SCORE may call mintTo, while Governance can raise the ceiling.
controls.evidence: The active bnUSD SCORE returned this registered Loans address. Its exact v1.1.2 deployed archive permits mintTo only from getLoans() or getStabilityFund(), and its mint implementation rejects supply above the configured debt ceiling.

controls.label: Balanced Peg Stability SCORE
controls.capDescription: At ICON block 115645618, the bnUSD SCORE debt ceiling was 8,000,000 bnUSD; only the registered Loans or Peg Stability SCORE may call mintTo, while Governance can raise the ceiling.
controls.evidence: The active bnUSD SCORE returned this registered Peg Stability address. Its exact v1.1.2 deployed archive permits mintTo only from getLoans() or getStabilityFund(), and its mint implementation rejects supply above the configured debt ceiling.

controls.label: Balanced Governance owner
controls.capDescription: The Governance SCORE owns bnUSD and its single current EOA owner can execute Governance calls that raise the debt ceiling or deploy replacement mint-critical SCORE code without an on-chain vote delay.
controls.evidence: At block 115645618, the active Governance SCORE owner was this hx account and the bnUSD SCORE owner was the Governance SCORE. The exact v1.0.3 deployed archive gates execute() and deployTo() to that SCORE owner, allowing it to change bnUSD's debt ceiling or mint-critical SCORE code.

review.evidence: The historical documentation describes a collateralized bnUSD CDP. At ICON block 115645618, the tracked canonical bnUSD SCORE was active (v1.1.2), had an 8,000,000 bnUSD debt ceiling, and registered the Loans and Peg Stability SCOREs as its only direct minters. The exact deployed v1.1.2 archive enforces those checks. The SCORE is owned by Balanced Governance, whose current owner is the single hx account above; the exact deployed v1.0.3 Governance archive exposes owner-only execute() and deployTo() paths. This establishes a scoreable concentrated-admin mint and upgrade authority rather than the earlier no-RPC uncertainty.
review.reviewer: TERRA-III Safety Score V9 control review

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Balanced markets bnUSD as usable across many chains and describes cross-chain connectivity through xCall/IBC-style messaging. Because holder movement is part of a cross-chain DeFi liquidity system rather than issuer redemption-only rails, the route is reviewed as liquidity-route risk.

notices.title: Primary issuance lives on ICON, not yet a Pharos-supported chain
notices.message: bnUSD is minted on ICON (canonical contract cx88fd7df7ddff82f7cc735c871dc519838cb235bb) where ~95% of supply currently sits. Balanced uses its xCall infrastructure to extend the same supply to other chains, so the EVM/Injective contracts tracked here represent cross-chain wraps of the ICON-issued supply. Additional active deployments on Archway and Havah (also not Pharos-supported), and on Optimism, are visible in DefiLlama but excluded from contracts[] until those chains are wired into Pharos.

notices.title: Balanced v1 transition and v2 launch
notices.message: Balanced's current documentation says v2 launched on April 7, 2026 and the original v1 app is no longer supported. The deployments tracked here are the historical v1 ICON-Hub bnUSD entry; current v2 issuance, reserves, and authority are not asserted until a verified active contract inventory is available.
